reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

bad: The report explains what caused the delay, how the company responded, and the reason of price increase.
The report explains what caused the delay, how the company responded, and why did prices rise.
The report explains what caused the delay, how did the company respond, and why prices rose.

cz.st: The report explains what caused the delay, how the company responded, and ___ prices rose.

patches.why: cz distractor "which" is grammatical (and which prices rose); bad[1] (the response of the company) is grammatical, only non-parallel. Replaced with clearly wrong forms.

bad: The island is famous not only for its beaches but also about its seafood.
The island is famous not only for its beaches but also famous seafood.
The island is famous not only its beaches but also for its seafood.

patches.why: bad[0] "also because of its seafood" is grammatical English (just not parallel); replaced with a clearly wrong preposition.

bad: Measles are a contagious disease that vaccines can prevent.
Measles is a contagious disease that vaccines can prevents.
Measles are contagious diseases that vaccines can prevent.

patches.why: bad[1] "that vaccine can prevent" (mass noun) is arguably acceptable; replaced with an unambiguous error.

bad: The new library offers free tutoring, quiet study rooms, and accessed online journals.
The new library offers free tutoring, quiet study rooms, and to access online journals.
The new library offers free tutoring, quiet study rooms, and that students can access online journals.

patches.why: bad[0] "and accessing online journals" is a grammatical gerund object parallel to tutoring; replaced with a wrong verb form.
intelligent/considerate can be swapped (both A and B), so word order of good is not unique.
